decision_logic: the published complete VZAA formulation is not qualified for SWAP5 exact accepted-step conservation and general lower-boundary requirements
literal Eq5 history has run-length-dependent state and O(N_layers*N_steps^2) direct trajectory work
an exactly conservative derivative shell is algebraically feasible but its physical predictor/history/coupling path is not qualified
the precommitted D0 donor hypothesis failed on the first ordinary homogeneous matrix and the F-VZAA02 contract requires expansion only if the signal is not immediately falsified
therefore D0-B/D0-C expansion and D1 bounded-history compression are not authorized from current evidence
no production VZAA solver family or VZAA-derived donor integration is justified
scope_limit: This is a fail-closed SWAP5 suitability decision under the current source and evidence set. It is not a universal scientific falsification of VZAA. The DOI-linked official MATLAB supplement remains uncaptured.
reopen_only_if: material new primary or official-code evidence changes the reconstructed method or resolves a hard gate
a new, explicitly scoped use case provides a distinct donor hypothesis that is not already falsified by the current D0 evidence
